博物馆在北京的另一种变体，出现在房地产开发商把“世界级”艺术区和博物馆的文化资本用作品牌策略之时。SOHO中国引领这一潮流，成为北京最大的房地产公司，其董事长潘石屹和首席执行官张欣跻身全国最富有的权势夫妇。当代置业集团（MOMA）通过用纽约现代艺术博物馆为接连开发的项目命名，培养出世界主义艺术、建筑与私有化住房之间更明显的联系。纽约建筑师斯蒂文·霍尔设计了他们的当代MOMA项目，这是一个获奖的八座混合用途塔楼建筑群，由空中环廊连接，2009年完工。[^zh-ch01-74] 2007年我参观该楼盘时，一位销售带我“虚拟”看房：先在发光的城市地图前做介绍；再穿过陈列项目建筑模型的玻璃展柜走廊；然后走过一套布置现代主义家具的样板间。最后，我拿到一袋宣传材料。


〔原书 77〕

A catalogue titled *A City within a City* opens by placing future architectural renderings of Beijing on par with other global cities.[^en-ch01-75] An accompanying DVD features Steven Holl introducing the project. During a segment in which a Matisse painting cross-dissolves into a watercolor sketch of his Linked Hybrid design, Holl describes its location on the northeast corner of Beijing’s Second Ring Road: “A place that, I say, is analogous to being on Fifth Avenue and Sixtieth Street at Central Park. We envision an open project, which is created in the spirit of a pedestrian community, being able to walk to all the functions of the base. But not only that, on the twentieth floor there is a ring, a sky ring, of additional functions that really create something utopian in a way, where one isn’t just inhabiting an apartment. It’s like inhabiting a new world.”[^en-ch01-76]

一本题为《城中城》的图录开篇，把北京未来的建筑效果图与其他全球城市并置。[^zh-ch01-75] 随附DVD中，斯蒂文·霍尔介绍这个项目。在一个片段里，马蒂斯一幅画渐变为他“连接复合体”设计的水彩草图，霍尔这样描述项目在北京二环路东北角的位置：“这个地方，我说，就像在第五大道和第六十街的中央公园。我们设想一个开放的项目，以步行社区的精神创造，能够步行抵达基地的所有功能。不仅如此，在二十层还有一个环，一个空中环廊，提供更多功能，真正在某种意义上创造出乌托邦式的东西，让人不只是住在一套公寓里。那就像住在一个新世界里。”[^zh-ch01-76]


〔原书 77〕

The formal analogy of Holl’s design sketch with Matisse’s *La Danse* reinforces the global city and art image presented by the moma Modern Land Group (plate 5).[^en-ch01-77] It also highlights the architectural qualities—movement, porosity, and luminosity—Holl discusses as central to his aesthetic. Holl explains the caption written at the top of the watercolor, “filmic urban space beijing”: cinema serves “as an emblem” of his design. He describes the sky ring functioning like a film loop, and his design places a movie theater, imagined as a community gathering point, at its center. The animated rendering of this theater projects a scene from the 1934 Chinese silent film *Goddess* on its screen. The cinema design includes a porous wall so that the iconic face of the film’s star Ruan Lingyu shines through to the building’s exterior and reflects in the pool of water surrounding it. This invocation of *Goddess* as marketing device alienates the film from its roots in nascent socialist realism. Ruan Lingyu, herself a working-class girl catapulted to silver screen fame and scandal who committed suicide at the age of twenty-four, plays a prostitute consumed by predatory elements in colonial-era capitalist Shanghai. When rage borne of injustice drives her to murder, her glamorous façade, like that of the city, glimmers with revolutionary potential. In an analysis of the relationship between architecture and cinema in Holl’s project James Tweedie writes, “But flickering on its walls and screen are several potentially conflicting conceptions of cinema, ranging from the age-old dream of a medium to document the political realities of the present to the desire for a museum-like medium that preserves the national past in all its spectacle and splendor.”[^en-ch01-78]

霍尔设计草图与马蒂斯《舞蹈》的形式类比，强化了当代置业集团所呈现的全球城市与艺术形象（图版5）。[^zh-ch01-77] 它也突显了霍尔视为其美学核心的建筑特质——运动、通透与明亮。霍尔解释水彩画上方的文字“电影般的城市空间：北京”：电影“作为其设计的象征”。他说空中环廊像电影循环一样运作，设计把一座被视为社区聚会点的电影院放在中心。这座影院的动画效果图在银幕上投射1934年中国默片《神女》的场景。影院设计包括一面通透的墙，使影片明星阮玲玉的标志性面孔透到建筑外墙，并倒映在环绕建筑的水池中。把《神女》调用为营销手段，使影片脱离其早期社会主义现实主义的根源。阮玲玉本人是从工人阶级女孩一跃成为银幕明星并卷入丑闻、二十四岁自杀身亡的人，她在影片中扮演一个在殖民时代资本主义上海被掠夺性力量吞噬的妓女。当不公带来的愤怒驱使她杀人时，她光鲜的外表，像这座城市一样，闪烁着革命潜能。詹姆斯·特威迪在分析霍尔项目中建筑与电影的关系时写道：“但在它的墙壁和银幕上闪烁的，是几种可能相互冲突的电影观念，从记录当下政治现实的媒介这一由来已久的梦想，到渴望一种类似博物馆的媒介，以其全部的奇观与辉煌保存民族的过去。”[^zh-ch01-78]


〔原书 77, 78〕

Many artists at the turn of the millennium viewed state-controlled institutions like the National Art Museum of China as retrograde and actively explored alternative exhibition venues. New art centers within commodity apartment real estate developments offered one possibility. They served as a medium ground between public and private within construction sites of dream and upheaval. Xing Danwen, Central Academy of Fine Arts graduate and photographer of the East Village art scene in the mid-1990s, examined conflicting conceptions of display in her series *Backstage* and *Urban Fiction*. Taken together, they probe the linkage between state commissioning of international star architects to design Beijing’s capital monuments, the ubiquitous visual imagery of architectural models, and the labor and lived experience behind the aesthetics of China’s new urbanism. The color photographs of *Backstage* record in documentary detail the construction site of the National Grand Theater designed by Paul Andreu. An image from above surveys the scale of the project, with the Great Hall of the People pushed to its edge, while others focus on the life of rural migrant workers on site: rows of portable toilets, a metal rice bowl on dirt ground. *Urban Fiction* captures instead the gendered alienation, ennui, and violence of new privatized forms of dwelling. For this series, created from 2004 to 2009, Xing photographed architectural scale models created for real estate developments. She then digitally edited the photographs to add isolated scenes so small the viewer has to search to find them. The characters in the scenes are all Xing dressed in different roles: an office worker on the phone gazing out the window, a woman floating alone in a villa swimming pool, a woman about to jump from the roof of a high-rise, a fleeing bride in the plaza of a planned community.

世纪之交的许多艺术家认为中国美术馆这类国家控制的机构落后，并积极探索替代性展览场所。商品房房地产开发项目中的新艺术中心提供了一种可能。它们在梦想与动荡的工地中，充当公私之间的中间地带。邢丹文是中央美院毕业生，也是90年代中期东村艺术现场的摄影者，她在《后台》和《都市演义》系列中考察相互冲突的展示观念。合在一起，它们探究国家委托国际明星建筑师设计北京首都纪念碑、无处不在的建筑模型视觉图像，以及中国新城市主义美学背后的劳动与生活经验之间的联系。《后台》的彩色照片以纪实细节记录保罗·安德鲁设计的国家大剧院工地。一张俯拍照片呈现项目规模，人民大会堂被挤到画面边缘；其他照片聚焦工地上农村移民的生活：成排的移动厕所、泥地上的金属饭盆。《都市演义》则捕捉新私有化居住形式中性别化的疏离、倦怠与暴力。这个系列创作于2004年至2009年，邢丹文拍摄为房地产开发项目制作的建筑模型，再用数码方式编辑照片，加入孤立的小场景，小到观者必须寻找才能发现。场景中的人物都由邢丹文扮演，穿着不同角色：一位打电话的上班族凝视窗外，一位独自漂浮在别墅泳池中的女人，一位正要跳下高楼屋顶的女人，一位在规划社区广场上逃跑的新娘。


〔原书 78〕

Within the soho China scale model a woman in a purple wig and sunglasses stands with her hands raised in shock. Her top has been ripped open. On the pristine white floor before her lie a bloody cleaver, the body of a white male in a pool of blood, and a scattered bouquet of flowers (plates 6 and 7). In the Grand moma model, a woman walking two daschunds through the sky ring is about to collide with a female window washer in a blue uniform. That Xing herself embodies both characters highlights the contradictory role of Chinese contemporary artists caught between historical registers, as cultural workers who endeavor to represent “the people” or the nation’s arrival as a cosmopolitan player. The replication and manipulation of the artist’s own image highlight how vanguard visions of inhabiting a new world depend on gendered imagery. The dancing nude, the treaty-port prostitute, the rosy-cheeked young pioneer, the market-reform lady of leisure pile up at the doors to the kingdom of culture.

在SOHO中国模型里，一个戴紫色假发和墨镜的女人双手惊举。她的上衣被撕开。她面前洁白的地板上有一把带血的菜刀、一具躺在血泊中的白人男性尸体和散落的花束（图版6、7）。在当代MOMA模型里，一个牵着两只腊肠犬走过空中环廊的女人，即将与一位穿蓝色制服的女性擦窗工相撞。邢丹文自己扮演两个角色，突显中国当代艺术家夹在历史层次之间的矛盾角色：作为文化工作者，他们努力再现“人民”，或再现国家作为世界主义玩家的抵达。对艺术家自身形象的复制与操纵，突显了栖居新世界的前卫愿景如何依赖性别化图像。跳舞的裸女、通商口岸的妓女、脸颊红润的年轻先锋队员、改革年代的休闲女士，堆积在文化王国的大门之外。

[^en-ch01-11]: There are parallels between the mid-1990s assertion by urban planners of Beijing’s primacy as China’s cultural center and early twentieth-century efforts to make it a modern metropolis whose showcasing of Chinese tradition would gain world stature. In “Defining Beiping,” Madeleine Dong details how urban planners sought to develop a self-sustaining economy after the Chinese capital moved from Beijing to Nanjing in 1928. They promoted a 1933 plan to turn it into a tourist city and another in 1935 for the “construction of a China-based Culture” centered in Beiping as a “reflection of national confidence.”

[^zh-ch01-11]: 1990年代中期城市规划者主张北京作为中国文化中心的首要地位，这与20世纪初把北京建设为现代大都市、通过展示中国传统而赢得世界声望的努力之间存在相似之处。在 "Defining Beiping" 中，董玥（Madeleine Dong）详述了1928年中国首都从北京迁往南京后，城市规划者如何寻求发展一种自给自足的经济。他们推动了1933年把北平变成旅游城市的计划，以及1935年另一项以北平为中心"建设中国本位文化"的计划，后者被视为"民族自信心的体现"。

[^en-ch01-12]: Anagnost, “The Corporeal Politics of Quality (*Suzhi*).” She and other anthropologists investigating the rural-urban question in China document the deep impact of these discursive and material shifts in the voice of rural citizens referring to themselves as “dead brains” and to the countryside as a “field of death.” Liu, *In One’s Own Shadow*; and Yan, “Spectralization of the Rural.”

[^zh-ch01-12]: Anagnost, "The Corporeal Politics of Quality (Suzhi)"。她与其他研究中国城乡问题的民族志学者记录了这些话语与物质变迁的深刻影响：农村公民自称"死脑筋"，把乡村称为"死亡之地"。Liu, *In One's Own Shadow*；以及 Yan, "Spectralization of the Rural"。

[^en-ch01-13]: As Zhang argues in her analysis of official policy on Beijing’s rural-to-urban migrants in *Strangers in the City*, the state exerted influence through new forms of governmentality. Micropractices shaping citizen conduct occurred through social institutions such as family relations, schools, and the marketplace, so that neither the state nor capital could be seen as external to the other.

[^zh-ch01-13]: 正如张鹂在分析官方关于北京农民工政策时于 *Strangers in the City* 中所论，国家通过新的治理术形式施加影响。塑造公民行为的微观实践通过家庭关系、学校和市场等社会机构发生，因此国家与资本都不能被视为彼此外在的东西。

[^en-ch01-46]: The composition and subject matter of this 1960 photograph bear striking resemblance to European depictions of the academic art ideal, fellow educated professionals joined in study of the nude figure as the representation of enlightenment reason. Johann Zoffany’s *The Academicians of the Royal Academy* (1772), for example, portrays academy members amid plaster casts in the Life Room on the Strand in London. They fix their attention on a nude male model just right of center. As Parker and Pollock point out in *Old Mistresses*, 87–90, Zoffany’s painting also documents gender divisions. The Royal Academy included two female members, both accomplished painters, one a founding member of the academy, who nonetheless were not allowed to study nude models in the Life Room. In order to accurately record the academy’s membership, Zoffany included the women in the form of two portraits hanging on the wall behind the model.

[^zh-ch01-46]: 这张1960年照片的构图与题材，与欧洲描绘学院艺术理想的图像有惊人的相似：受过教育的专业人士聚集在一起研究裸体，以此作为启蒙理性的表征。例如，约翰·佐法尼（Johann Zoffany）的《皇家艺术学院院士》（1772）描绘了学院成员在伦敦河岸街写生教室的石膏像之间。他们的注意力集中在画面中央偏右一名男性裸体模特身上。正如帕克与波洛克在 *Old Mistresses*, 87–90 中所指出的，佐法尼的画作也记录了性别区隔。皇家艺术学院曾有两名女性成员，二人都是成就卓著的画家，其中一人还是创院院士，却不被允许在写生教室研究裸体模特。为了准确记录学院成员，佐法尼把这两位女性画成挂在模特身后墙上的两幅肖像。

[^en-ch01-49]: Anagnost, “The Corporeal Politics of Quality (*Suzhi*),” tracks how Chinese suzhi discourse from the late 1980s on reflected the changing relationship between value and bodies during economic reform. Techniques from institutional campaigns to popular self-help manuals exhorted citizens to raise the quality of the nation by raising their own “quality.” Anagnost argues that the practices of distinction that characterized a “person of quality” depended on new forms of consumption and a middle-class desire for upward social mobility. Woronov in “The Eye of the Chicken” looks specifically at *suzhi jiaoyu* to argue how children of migrant workers in Beijing are educated to learn their place in new spatial and social hierarchies as backward in relation to urban residents.

[^zh-ch01-49]: Anagnost, "The Corporeal Politics of Quality (Suzhi)" 追踪了1980年代末以来中国"素质"话语如何反映经济改革中价值与身体之间变化的关系。从制度性运动到通俗自助手册的各种技术，都劝诫公民通过提高自身"素质"来提高民族素质。阿纳格诺斯特主张，构成"有素质的人"的区分实践，依赖于新的消费形式以及中产阶级向上社会流动的欲望。Woronov 在 "The Eye of the Chicken" 中专门考察素质教育，论证北京的农民工子女如何被教育去认识自己在新空间与社会等级中的位置——相对于城市居民而言是落后的。

[^en-ch01-50]: Parents eagerly espoused the most minute of practices in discussions of raising their children’s *suzhi*. One mother explained to me that American children sleep on their sides instead of their backs, like Chinese children, making their faces thinner and more attractive.

[^zh-ch01-50]: 在讨论提高孩子素质时，父母们热切地采纳最细微的做法。一位母亲向我解释说，美国孩子不像中国孩子那样仰睡，而是侧睡，这会使他们的脸更瘦、更好看。

[^en-ch01-67]: One of Zhu’s early video pieces, *Forever* (1994), was filmed using a similar method. He attached a camera to the back wheel of a bicycle cart and pedaled through Beijing. The camera recorded the wheel’s cyclical movement, halting at traffic stops and randomly capturing urban scenes from different angles. *Forever* puts knowledge of a place in postmodern spin, disrupting Zhu’s day job in official image management and recalling Lao She’s classic novel *Rickshaw Boy*, a left-leaning indictment of individualism serially published beginning in 1937. The novel’s protagonist struggles to survive and maintain his dignity as he pulls a range of characters through Beijing—“filthy, beautiful, decrepit, lively, chaotic, peaceful, and charming.” Lao, *Rickshaw Boy*, 290.

[^zh-ch01-67]: 朱加早期的一件录像作品《永远》（1994）就是用类似方法拍摄的。他把摄像机绑在一辆自行车拖车的后轮上，骑车穿过北京。摄像机记录车轮的循环运动，在红绿灯前停下，并随机从不同角度捕捉城市景象。《永远》让关于一个地方的知识陷入后现代的旋转，扰乱了朱加在官方图像管理中的日常工作，也令人想起老舍的经典小说《骆驼祥子》；这部带有左翼倾向、批判个人主义的作品自1937年起连载。小说主人公拉着形形色色的乘客穿过北京——"肮脏的、美丽的、衰败的、活泼的、混乱的、安静的、迷人的"——为生存与尊严而挣扎。Lao, *Rickshaw Boy*, 290。
